general_source_prompt: You are an expert {language} analyst and technical documentation writer. Please analyze the following {language} program and create comprehensive markdown documentation with embedded mermaid.js diagrams. Your answer should report only a valid markdown document, without any additional comment and the document should follow this structure: # {filename} ## Package `{package_name}` ## Functional Overview [Provide a clear description of the program's purpose, responsibilities, and key features] ## Data Structures [Document all data structures with detailed tables and ER diagrams. Ensure to list every field and their purpose without omissions.] ### Input/Output Data [Create tables describing all data formats, fields, and their purposes. Include every field, and make sure not to omit any details.] ### Entity Relationship Diagram [Create a mermaid.js ER diagram showing relationships between data structures.] ## Program Flow [Document the program's execution flow and all functions, ensuring no details are left out.] ### Control Flow Diagram [Create a mermaid.js flowchart showing program structure and function relationships.] ### Functions and Procedures [Document all functions with their parameters, purposes, and relationships. List every function/procedure without skipping any.] ## External Dependencies [List and describe all external dependencies and their purposes. Make sure no dependency is omitted.] Here is the {language} code to analyze: ```{language} {content} ``` Please provide a complete markdown file that: 1. Thoroughly explains what the program does and its role in the system 2. Documents all data structures with their fields and relationships 3. Lists all functions/procedures with their parameters and purposes 4. Shows program flow using mermaid.js flowcharts 5. Shows data relationships using mermaid.js ER diagrams 6. Lists all external dependencies with their purposes 7. Make sure no dependency/function/procedure is omitted and all data details are complete, even if they are many. Use mermaid.js for all diagrams and focus on clarity and completeness.
general_summary_prompt: You are an expert technical documentation writer. Please analyze the following markdown documents and create a comprehensive summary. Your answer should report only a valid markdown document, without any additional comment and the document should follow this structure: # {folder_name} Documentation Summary ## Overview [Provide a high-level summary of this component/module's purpose and responsibilities] ## Key Components [List and briefly describe all the components/programs in this module, ensuring no details are left out.] ## Functional Areas [Group and summarize the main functional areas covered by these components] ### Entity Relationship Diagram [Create a comprehensive mermaid.js ER diagram showing relationships between data structures presented in the text, ensuring no details are left out.] ## Dependencies [Summarize the key external dependencies and integrations. Make sure no dependency is omitted.] Here are the markdown documents to analyze: {md_contents} Please provide a complete markdown summary that: 1. Gives a clear high-level overview of this module's purpose 2. Lists and explains the key components 3. Groups functionality into logical areas 4. Identifies common patterns and dependencies 5. Maintains technical accuracy while being concise Focus on creating a coherent narrative that helps understand how these components work together.

Maintains all technical details from the source documentation 2. Preserves all functional descriptions, procedures, and data structures 3. Creates a coherent narrative of how all components work together 4. Ensures no technical details or functionality is omitted 5. Organizes information in a clear hierarchical structure Focus on technical accuracy and completeness while providing a clear system-level view.
